question: A shop offers either a single discount of 55% or two successive discounts of 30% and 35%. Which is better for the buyer?

question: The tax on cement is decreased by 40% and, as a result, its consumption is increased by 60%. What is the change in the tax collected on it?
solution: Tax collected = tax rate × consumption: 0.6 × 1.6 = 0.96, a 4% decrease.
questionHi: सीमेंट पर कर 40% घटाया जाता है और इससे उसकी खपत 60% बढ़ जाती है। उस पर वसूले गए कर में क्या परिवर्तन होता है?
solutionHi: वसूला गया कर = कर की दर × खपत: 0.6 × 1.6 = 0.96, यानी 4% कमी।
